notablePrerequisites: You control two lands that collectively tap for enough to cast Lutri.
easyPrerequisites: There is a creature on the battlefield.
description:
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting any creature.
With the original Snap on the stack, cast Lutri.
Resolve the Lutri ETB, causing you to create a copy of Snap and change its target to Lutri.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Lutri to your hand and untapping two lands that produce enough to recast it.
Repeat from step 2.
